# Modeling and Simulation for Test and Evaluation Guidebook

> **External, not NASA governance.** Useful for comparison and vocabulary. It never establishes
> what NASA requires, and must not be cited as NASA coverage.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Publisher / owner** | Office of the Director, Developmental Test, Evaluation, and Assessments and Office of the Director, Operational Test and Evaluation; Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Research and Engineering |
| **Kind** | Guidebook (DoD T&E community guidance) |
| **Status** | May 2025 edition. DOPSR Case # 25-T-1804. |
| **Where to get it** | Public: cto.mil/dtea and dote.osd.mil; Distribution Statement A, approved for public release, distribution unlimited. Public copy, confirmed anonymously off-network on 2026-10-26: `https://www.cto.mil/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/MS-TE-Guidebook-May-2025-1.pdf` |
| **Binds whom** | DoD test teams using modeling and simulation (M&S) in support of T&E — guidance, not a binding directive. |

**What it is good for, relative to NASA's documents.** The closest DoD counterpart in subject matter to
NASA-STD-7009B (models and simulations), from a different domain and issued by a different authority
(our reading).

**Key content for AI / machine-learning assurance.** 🔴 **No AI/ML content found.** A text search of the public PDF for "artificial intelligence" and "machine learning" returned zero hits; "algorithm"/"algorithms"
appeared only 4 times, in a general M&S-verification context, not tied to learned models. This
guidebook addresses traditional M&S credibility for T&E and does not, in its text, address
AI/ML-based models as a distinct category (our reading).

**Nearest NASA counterpart.** `../documents/NASA-STD-7009B.md` is the direct subject-matter
counterpart — both address models-and-simulations credibility for decision support, though NASA-STD-
7009B is explicitly "not mandatory" by default (see `../documents/NASA-STD-7009B.md`) while this
guidebook is DoD T&E community guidance under a different authority (our reading, comparison only).
